text:
Liam (Sales): Quick one 1 Acme's security team asked if we can provide a short, time-limited SOC2 evidence snapshot for their evaluation POC. They want logs+config screenshots and confirmation of KMS usage. Asking for 1 week access. Can we do presigned access + bridge letter instead of sending the whole report? @Priya @Noor
Sam (SE): Yes, we can assemble a scoped bundle: filtered app logs (errors + auth events), redacted access logs, and screenshots of IAM/KMS settings. No DB dumps, no secrets.
Priya (Legal): NDA required before we share. We'll need recipient list and a signed non-disclosure. Bridge letter must state this is a limited snapshot and not a SOC2 attestation.
Noor (Security): Agreed. We'll run a redaction pass (IPs, userids, API tokens) and add a manifest with SHA256 hashes for each file. Also include a README describing sampling and redaction.
Liam (Sales): @Daniel who will sign the NDA on Acme side and who needs access (names + emails)?
Daniel (Acme): Rachel (rachel@acmehealth.com) will sign NDA. Access for rachel@acmehealth.com, me (daniel@acmehealth.com), and eng-poc@acmehealth.com. 7 days works.
Alex (SalesOps): Once NDA is uploaded we'll generate a presigned S3 bundle link and produce the bridge-letter PDF from internal template. Link will be expiry-bound and we will log access.
DocBot (automation): NDA upload detected: https://redwood.internal/ndas/ACME-2006-signed.pdf (ACL: restricted).
Priya (Legal): Received NDA. I'll draft a scoped bridge that references the NDA ID, lists recipients, and includes permitted uses + non-reliance clause. Draft in ~1 hour.
Sam (SE): Bundle prep checklist: 1) Logs trimmed to last 30 days and sampled; 2) Config screenshots (auth, KMS, network ACLs); 3) Short readme on what was redacted; 4) Manifest + deletion note.
Noor (Security): Also ensure S3 bucket has directory listing disabled, presigned URL TTL = 7 days, and server-side encryption with KMS on the objects. We'll call out encryption in the bridge letter.
Priya (Legal): Draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bridge-drafts/ACME-snapshot-2006-draft.pdf. Key points: timebox, non-distribution, no reliance, and deletion after expiry. Please review.
Sam (SE): Reviewed. Minor tweak: explicitly state that API key-like strings are redacted and that request bodies are excluded.
Noor (Security): Approved from security. README has redaction checklist and sampling notes.
Liam (Sales): Once Rachel signs NDA, Priya will countersign bridge and SalesOps will post the presigned link only to the recipient emails. We'll include directions to request extended access and note that extended access may incur POC support fees. @Alex pls prepare pricing note.
Alex (SalesOps): Pricing note: standard POC snapshot included once per account. Extensions or additional evidence exports fall under POC Support add-on pricing. I'll include contact salesops@redwood.com for extensions.
DocBot (automation): Bridge-letter signed and archived: https://redwood.internal/bridge-signed/ACME-bridge-2006.pdf
Alex (SalesOps): Presigned S3 link prepared and delivered to recipients via secure channel. Reminder: DO NOT paste link in public channels. Expiry: 2025-06-17T12:00:00Z (7 days).
Daniel (Acme): Link received, downloading now. Thanks for the fast turnaround.
Liam (Sales): Great. After expiry we'll remove objects and post deletion confirmation here with manifest deletion timestamp.
Noor (Security): Make sure the access and deletion events are recorded in audit logs and retention policies enforce deletion.
Priya (Legal): Also keep a copy of the signed NDA + bridge in contract archive.
Liam (Sales): Closing loop 1 thanks folks. If Acme asks for CAIQ/SSP later we can coordinate that as a separate request. :thumbsup:
